source.title: An Experimental Study on the Large-Volume Liquid Hydrogen Release in an Open Space
source.data_availability_statement: Original contributions are included in the article; further inquiries are directed to the corresponding author.

claim_boundary: This open-access article provides actual-LH2 open-space release observations and report-level sensor geometry, but no rights-cleared raw time series or machine-readable station coordinates are committed here. It may support cautious explanations of cryogenic release, near-source accumulation, ground effects and delayed far-field arrival; it must not calibrate runtime dispersion, safety distances or independent validation gates.
